messages:
Maya (PMM): quick brainstorm 1: we need a webinar that 1) teaches folks how to think about cost vs latency, 2) shows a simple live demo, 3) leaves time for buyer questions. thoughts on format?
Jordan (Growth): i like a short tutorial + one live micro-demo. keep the demo focused (one prompt that highlights batching/caching). i can lead the demo if needed.
Sofia (Producer): logistics: we should schedule 3 rehearsals across timezones. propose: tech-check (Tue 9am PT), full run (Wed 2pm PT), dress (Thu 9am PT). will anyone be OOO?
Ravi (AE): available for all except Thu morning. i'll prepare 2 real-customer prompts: one quick Q->A, one multi-turn summary.
Maya (PMM): speaker ask: 6 slides max for benchmarks, 1 slide for fallback policy, 1 CTA slide. keep technical details in appendix in google slides.
Jordan (Growth): demo plan (short): set context, call Redwood API with variant tuned for latency, show p95 meter, then toggle to higher-throughput variant to show cost drop and slight latency change. note: streaming outputs will make it feel responsive.
Liam (Ops): ops checklist: latency dashboard in console, live token-meter, fallback recording (2m), second demo machine, VPN creds, host phone. i'll provision a spare GPU instance in case of region throttling.
Sofia (Producer): run-of-show draft: 
- 0:00-0:03 intro + host welcome
- 0:03-0:09 benchmark highlights + why this matters
- 0:09-0:19 live demo (host + demo)
- 0:19-0:35 customer scenarios + AE walk-through
- 0:35-0:55 live Q&A
- 0:55-0:56 CTA + close
Keep demo handoff to 20s.
Maya (PMM): CTA: early access waitlist for Dedicated and a benchmark whitepaper download. capture utm and product interest.
Jordan (Growth): routing: registrant -> hubspot list "webinar_may_infer" -> sales owner if company_size > 250 -> otherwise nurture. embed will be /webinars/rl-inference?utm=web.
Ravi (AE): will script the fallback clip and share an mp4 by EOD tomorrow. we should rehearse the fallback commentary so host can pivot quickly.
Sofia (Producer): rehearsal invites will include link to google slides + demo script. greenroom-bot: please nudge 24h and 30m before.
greenroom-bot: reminders set for Tue/Wed/Thu rehearsals at 24h and 30m. :ok_hand:
Maya (PMM): attendees: invite engineering customers + platform leads. ask marketing to push to community and partners.
Jordan (Growth): will draft invite copy: emphasize "production economics" and a live reliability demo. also call out we'll show fallback behavior.
Sofia (Producer): action items: Maya finalize abstract + audience; Jordan embed + demo script; Ravi fallback clip; Liam ops checklist + spare instance; me send invites + schedule rehearsals. publish invite target: next Monday.
Maya (PMM): sample abstract snippet: "Explore how to balance latency, cost, and reliability when serving LLMs in production. See live demos of fallback and routing policies and get a practical checklist for deployment." feedback?
Jordan (Growth): sounds good. add a line about real metrics (p50/p95 cost).
Ravi (AE): added note: include a quick customer quote slide (1 sentence) to anchor the use case.
Sofia (Producer): all set. closing thread 1. will post calendar invites + doc links. :white_check_mark:
